Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Storage Class¶

class Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Storage(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Storage commands are used to set the related parameters when storing images.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
get_image_color()[source]¶

Query the image color when storing images.

Parameter: None

Return: str: “ON” or “OFF”

get_image_invert()[source]¶

Query the status of the invert function when storing images.

Parameter: None

Return: str: “ON” or “OFF”

get_image_type()[source]¶

Query the image type when storing images.

Parameter: None

Return: str: Image type

set_image_color(state)[source]¶

Set the image color when storing images to color (ON) or intensity graded color (OFF).

Parameter: state (int or str): 1/0 or “ON”/”OFF”

Return: None

set_image_invert(state)[source]¶

Turn on or off the invert function when storing images.

Parameter: state (int or str): 1/0 or “ON”/”OFF”

Return: None

set_image_type(img_type)[source]¶

Set the image type when storing images.

Parameter: img_type (str): “PNG”, “BMP8”, “BMP24”, “JPEG”, “TIFF”

Return: None
